params.text: - `gh.api` explains a misplaced options object, and `gh` suggestions put likely methods first (#382). A call such as `gh.api(endpoint, { method })` gets an error that shows `gh api` flag examples and says process options go third. `Did you mean` and the `gh has:` list put methods whose names start with the missing name first, so `gh.pr` suggests `prCreate`, `prList`, `prMerge`, and `prView`.
